name: monero_node_module
description: Fail-closed monerod JSON-RPC client and the Monero wallet's node per network. "Use Tor for" (all, identifying or none) picks a direct node or one over Tor, the Tor that comes with Logos (tor_module) by default. Never runs a node itself; local mode dials the one monerod_module runs.
author: Logos Core Team
